plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/24692
Issue label NAICS 62 is wrong; body NAICS 6211 is also off. Victim is a securities broker: coded 523120. Title mentions Shinhan Bank/Bithumb but the body describes Daishin Securities, which is coded here.
AI angle: CrowdStrike attributed the earlier wave of the campaign to a China-developed AI-driven pen-testing tool (ARTEX); not attributed to Daishin specifically, so actor Unknown. Issue is not tagged AI related.
Asset: S - Web application (server supporting online account opening, attacked with disguised requests). Encrypted account/phone numbers do not change state coding; stored state 'Stored'.
Incident date coded Oct 2026 (detection Oct 17; campaign from late Sept). Discovery internal Log review is implied by 'reviewed requests' but detection method not stated: unknown.

summary: South Korea's financial regulators confirmed on October 28, 2026 that Daishin Securities had been breached by hackers who accessed a server supporting online securities account openings, exposing personal and credit information of 38,490 customers, including names, email and home addresses, login IDs and encrypted account and phone numbers. The breach was detected October 17 after the company identified unauthorized access and reviewed over 60,000 disguised requests. The attack was part of a broader campaign against about 20 South Korean financial firms since late September.
